experience.es:
Abogada y Consultora Legal con más de 16 años de experiencia en asesoría integral para los sectores público y privado. Especialista en Derechos Humanos, Políticas Públicas para la Infancia y Gestión de la Calidad Educativa. Posee una sólida trayectoria en litigio civil, comercial y penal, destacándose por su rol actual como Curadora Procesal ante la Corte Superior de Justicia de Lima.

Facultad de Ciencias Administrativas: Catedrática de Derecho Empresarial, Sociología de la Empresa y Derecho Constitucional.

experience.en:
Legal Consultant and Attorney with over 16 years of experience providing comprehensive advisory services for both the public and private sectors. Specialist in Human Rights, Public Policy for Children and Adolescents, and Educational Quality Management. Proven track record in civil, commercial, and criminal litigation, currently serving as a Court-Appointed Guardian (Curadora Procesal) for the Superior Court of Justice of Lima.


2. EDUCATION SECTOR (2015 – 2021)
UNIVERSIDAD INCA GARCILASO DE LA VEGA

2.1. Administrative Management
Head of the University Ombudsman’s Office (2019 – 2021).

Head of the Personnel Records and Control Office (2017 – 2018).

2.2. Teaching Experience
Faculty of Law and Political Science: Professor of History of Peruvian Law, Municipal Law, Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR), and Notarial & Registry Law.

Faculty of Administrative Sciences: Professor of Corporate Law, Business Sociology, and Constitutional Law.
